title: Russian general killed by car bomb in Moscow, investigators say
summary: Investigative Committee says it is looking into whether Ukraine intelligence services were behind the attack A Russian general was killed on Monday morning after an explosive device detonated underneath his car in southern Moscow, investigators said. Lt Gen Fanil Sarvarov, the head of the operational training directorate of the Russian armed forces’ general Staff, died from his injuries, said Svetlana Petrenko, official spokesperson for Russia’s Investigative Committee. title: Investigators probing Ukraine link as Moscow car bomb kills Russian general
